title: Viking lander life tests read as finding life
summary: John Brandenburg tells of Viking lander life tests read as finding life, about 1976 at Mars, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And they got mixed results which now can be interpreted as they they found life

plain: John Brandenburg, a physicist who argues that Mars once held life, discussed this on Jesse Michels's podcast. He says that the experiments run in 1976 by the Viking landers, robot probes that set down on Mars to test the soil for life, gave mixed results that can now be read as having found life. If true, it would mean life on another world was detected decades ago.
